calibration_and_ambiguity_findings.finding: Under synthetic adverse monsoon conditions (darkness, blur, glare), the model maintains 100.0% flood recall under low light, 100.0% under high glare, and 52.0% under rain blur. However, the 0.65 threshold remains provisional until local daytime and nighttime Hyderabad flood captures are evaluated.

hyderabad_readiness_assessment.reason: While Model V2 demonstrates genuine semantic flood detection on external Clemson data (100% recall), the primary training set suffers from severe resolution disparity between classes. The model is safe for human-in-the-loop advisory triage, but must not be deployed as an autonomous warning system in Hyderabad without a balanced, native-resolution local dataset.
